visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three young people stand centered in a sunny palace courtyard. They wear vibrant Hanboks: a purple one, a green one with a patterned headscarf, and a pink one with a dark blue top. Behind them is a large wooden palace building with an intricate tiled roof and traditional red pillars. They smile broadly at the lens while looking at the camera. (2) The scene cuts to a red-walled palace corridor where two people in red and purple Hanboks perform a playful, bouncy dance. The lighting is bright and natural daylight, creating strong shadows. (3) A sequence of quick cuts shows various members of the group dancing in different sections of the palace grounds. One person wears large white sunglasses and a white fur shawl over their Hanbok. (4) A wide shot captures seven people lined up horizontally in the courtyard. They move their arms and legs in a synchronized, comedic rhythmic motion. One person in a lime-green Hanbok performs a handstand and a leg-split on the dirt ground. (5) The video ends with a montage of the group posing, leaning against palace walls, and smiling, with the final shot showing a person in a green Hanbok being spun around by a red-sleeved arm.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) An upbeat electronic background track begins with a sharp synthesized beat. A male voice sings a stylized, rhythmic 'Meow' refrain. The audio environment is clean and sterile, indicating a post-produced track without ambient location noise. (2) As the visuals cut to different scenes, a bouncy melodic synthesizer line interweaves with the vocal motif. The vocal quality is exaggerated and playful, with high pitch variability. (3) The rhythmic 'Meow' vocals repeat with high energy and a positive valence. The drum pattern is steady and provides a strong rhythmic backbone for the dancing on screen. (4) Subtle 'whoosh' transition sound effects are audible during the quick edits, synchronized with the jump cuts in the video. The track maintains a consistent major-mode tonality throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Series of playful dance clips -> Synchronized group dance -> Comedic conclusion.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a lighthearted travel vlog and social media challenge featuring a group of friends dressed in traditional Korean Hanboks at Gyeongbokgung Palace. The intent is to showcase their friendship and humor through synchronized, silly dancing to a popular meme song, emphasizing the 'disease' of their shared playfulness.
